definitions.explanation: A device used to protect from rain or sun. In Japanese, the same word covers both rain umbrellas and parasols.

examples.japanese: {傘|かさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行|い}きましょう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
{傘|かさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れました→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{傘|かさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: It's raining, so I need an umbrella.
I want to buy an umbrella; where do they sell them?

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{傘|かさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{出|で}かけました→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦{降|ふ}りませんでした→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: The weather forecast said rain, so I left with an umbrella, but in the end it didn't rain.

notes:
{傘|かさ} refers to both rain umbrellas and parasols/sunshades.

TYPES:
- {雨傘|あまがさ}: rain umbrella
- ⟦{日傘|ひがさ}→日傘：04686_higasa⟧: parasol, sunshade
- {折|お}りたたみ{傘|がさ}: folding umbrella
- ビニール{傘|がさ}: vinyl/plastic umbrella

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {傘|かさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：10965_sasu⟧: to hold up an umbrella
- {傘|かさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open an umbrella
- {傘|かさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧: to close an umbrella
- {傘|かさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to forget one's umbrella

CULTURAL NOTE:
Transparent vinyl umbrellas are ubiquitous in Japan and sold cheaply at convenience stores. ⟦{傘立|かさた}て→傘立て：07013_kasatate⟧ (umbrella stands) are common at entrances to buildings.
